name: Video Shots
description: One row per shot: linked video, shot number, timecode, scene, code reference, script line, note, recording status, asset.

agentPrompts.label: Add shots to a video's storyboard
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-demo-video-factory` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then add the shots I describe to the named video's storyboard — timecode, scene, script line, and code reference when the shot demos a real product surface. Leave recording-status as pending until it is actually recorded.

agentPrompts.label: Mark a shot recorded or needing a reshoot
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-demo-video-factory` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then update the recording-status of the shot I name to recorded or needs_reshoot, and attach the asset if I give you one.

agentPrompts.label: What's left to record?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-demo-video-factory` skill in this folder, then show me the shots still pending for the video I name (or across all videos), grouped by video with a recording-progress rollup.
